title: Work schedule and monthly pay on the WPA project
summary: Musicians played nights or rehearsed 9 to 1, and received a regular monthly income.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Well, how often did you work? Did you work every day?
Yeah, you worked like this. If we played at night, we didn't rehearse in the day. But if we didn't go on a job and play at night, then we would have to
rehearse. We would have to do -- we would have to put -- how many hours did we play, now? Nine -- four hours, when we rehearsed, because we'd start at 9:00 and we'd be through about 1:00.
And everybody received a weekly salary?
Yeah, they -- well, they got paid by the month. Yeah.
